mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 66 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, under the glow of the Full Moon.

The City of Verona has begun an eighteen-month project to update the 2026 Comprehensive Plan, which will serve as a long-term guide for local growth and land use, with a dedicated task force now overseeing the public participation process.
There is a busy schedule today with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, live music at Paddy Mac's, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.

Regarding local safety, on August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street involving minor injuries where drivers were cited for operating without insurance and failing to yield.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist, and you can stop by when the doors open today at 10:00 AM.
